objective: Turn a shopping candidate's material envelope and ownership burden into an explicit physical-fit question at a HOUSE address without creating a new store, planner or authority.
delta: SHOPPING candidate records may carry BODY W/D/H, OPERATING W/D/H, mass, maintenance and dependency burden.
SHOPPING → HOUSE transports only a session-local house-shopping-fit/v0.1 projection.
HOUSE asks for real available W/D/H at the currently selected spatial address and screens the operating envelope, including optional 90-degree rotation.
RETURN lands on the exact Shopping item through /shopping/#<item-id>.
DAYLINE Shopping handoffs now use the same exact item return address.

authority.shopping: candidate identity, purchase lifecycle, cost, burden and adoption evidence
authority.house: spatial address and local fit measurement context
authority.retained_boundary: No handoff purchases, promotes ownership, mutates canonical HOUSE geometry or actuates HA/HOUSEBUS.

proof: handoff schema present on both producer and consumer
missing dimensions produce UNKNOWN/MEASURE rather than inferred fit
residue: Doorway/path, service hookups, ventilation, load, cat clearance and installation constraints remain outside the envelope screen.
HOUSE recovered-donor/current-instance geometry conflict remains unchanged; fit probe therefore uses explicit user-measured zone W/D/H rather than deriving fit from donor plan geometry.
next_gate: Use one real candidate such as an appliance, litter system or storage object: enter BODY/OPERATING envelope → HOUSE FIT → measure one intended zone → RETURN to the exact Shopping item. Keep only if this reduces fit mistakes or measurement reconstruction.
